newsitem.title: USA: Grace completes share repurchase program.
newsitem.headline: Grace completes share repurchase program.

text.p: W.R. Grace & Co said Wednesday that it has substantially completed the share repurchase program launched in September 1996 following the disposition of its National Medical Care unit.
The company said that under this program, approximately 17.5 million shares were repurchased at an average price of $53.00 per share.

In addition, from April to September 1996, about 9.9 million shares were purchased in an earlier stock buyback program, said Grace. As a result of these programs, a total of approximately 27.4 million shares were repurchased.
Currently, Grace has approximately 73 million shares outstanding.
